rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
C = Q/V
C = ε₀A/d
U = ½CV²

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Energy stored in a capacitor" as one blob → ✅ split into: energy stored in a capacitor.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Capacitance C = Q/V; parallel-plate C = ε₀A/d (larger with dielectric: C = ε₀εᵣA/d).  ·  Energy stored U = ½CV² = Q²/2C.
